_doc: The motor ship «Полдень» as the people's life sees her (tools/ship/cruise_people.py, docs/ship.md): island 4, no way to or from the town. P-SHIP: the crew's posts (FWorld::StaffOnShift); P-SHIP-DINING: a place a chair; cabins: private flats; S-SHIP-SHORE: where the ship's people are while gone; S-PIER-CRUISE (island 0): where the cruising townsfolk wait for the launch.
